purpose: Canonical navigable index and append-only decision history for research continuity. Read this journal before proposing another COSMOS detector change. Each stage keeps its own exact receipts, code, protocols and artifacts; this index pins their observed versions and does not replace them.

source_snapshot.selection: JSON paths containing both COSMOS and SETI available in registry at creation

rules.append_only: Append a new event for each launch, calibration lock, result, failure, correction, hold or next hypothesis; do not erase earlier negative outcomes. Separate stage receipts may be updated with new verified results; pin old blob or commit here. Never record unobserved results as PASS.
reproducibility: frozen protocol and calibration lock hash
calibration and evaluation target IDs and data hashes
source/algorithm donor and external comparator refs
negative results; technical errors and fixes
production adoption and independent validation state
scientific_limits: new targets with artificial injections are not independent real positive sources
compare matched inputs and report realized controls
no posterior origin classification without independently sourced labels
GitHub Actions SUCCESS is not a scientific PASS
comparison with CPU kernels does not imply beating full pipelines
no production change until separately approved and validated

events.hypothesis: Star Forge lane learning and disjoint unseen-slice traversal may help schedule COSMOS search strategies under a finite compute budget.
events.decision: Preserve original source; investigate lane routing as scheduling only, not a change to calibrated detection truth. Reward must use independently verified localization/control outcomes per cost, not raw score maxima.

mechanics: five lanes DAWN ORBIT KYBER MERCY GROGU
EMA 31/32 history + mean + best + strong hit rate + capped shares + exploration + jitter
coprime stride within each disjoint slice and permutation of slices
replan queued for next unseen slice, no cursor reset

events.limitations: Original is SHA256 nonce traversal, not radio detection; lane choice changes order only, not hash truth. Learner resets per job. No evidence of cryptographic prediction or COSMOS sensitivity gain. No repeat only within a fixed job and fixed traversal schedule; physical data overlap must be handled separately.
events.next_gate: After R28B results, test donor scheduler on fresh labelled calibration and fixed eval tasks, compare fixed routing, exhaustive search, budgeted coverage and equal control rate; shared preprocessing and independent held-out targets. Do not learn from evaluation truth.
